facts.headline: Mizar Expands Alpha Program to BNB Chain
facts.summary: Mizar is expanding its Alpha Program to BNB Chain, letting traders earn $MZR rewards for activity on its automated and copy-trading platform. The program is a familiar liquidity-mining play: pay users to participate, and hope the activity outlasts the incentive that summoned it.
